purpose: Evidence-oriented descriptor of the isolated Forge Neo qualification runtime. This is NOT a production runtime/bootstrap contract (that belongs to PR-IMG-FORGE-110 after qualification passes) and nothing in StableNew launches Forge from this file.

bounded_review.reason: Forge API, launcher, Python/Torch/CUDA, model/VAE/reference and ControlNet source are unchanged. Kitchen changes affect quantized kernels; the selected checkpoint has only F16 tensors and no quantization keys, and Comfy-Kitchen attention is opt-in and not enabled by the frozen flags. This is source/metadata evidence, not physical parity evidence.

source.note: Re-fetch neo and compare against this commit before installation; if it moved, re-review the API matrix instead of silently advancing the pin.

python.venv: dedicated qualification venv; never the StableNew venv, the A1111 venv, or the managed Comfy venv

launch.port_rationale: StableNew's WebUI discovery scans 7860-7869; a distinct port outside that range keeps the Forge qualification endpoint from being auto-discovered as a default A1111.
launch.extension_safety_flags_rationale: The ADetailer extension otherwise downloads its default YOLO detectors from HuggingFace at startup. Model downloads are not authorized, so the no-download flag is required for a fail-closed run; it is listed separately from the frozen launch flags because it deviates from the three-flag launch contract and needs explicit owner approval.

dependency_install.authorization_required: owner (package downloads into the isolated venv only)
dependency_install.neo_requirements_file: requirements.txt at the pinned commit (exact pins, includes diffusers 0.37.1, transformers 4.57.6, numpy 2.3.5, fastapi 0.127.1)
dependency_install.model_downloads: NOT authorized (checkpoints, VAEs, LoRAs, ControlNet models, detectors)
dependency_install.adetailer_metadata_feasibility: Windows CPython 3.13.16: the proposed ADetailer closure has 45 package versions with compatible wheel metadata and no requirement conflicts against shared Forge direct pins. Ultralytics 8.3.253 accepts numpy 2.3.5; MediaPipe 0.10.31 has a non-yanked py3-none-win_amd64 wheel. Rich reuses Forge's pin. This is metadata feasibility for the ADetailer closure, not a complete Forge bootstrap lock or an installed/imported runtime verdict.
dependency_install.install_plan_blocker: Neo's unchanged launcher requests gradio==4.40.0 (Pillow>=8.0,<11.0), while its requirements.txt pins Pillow==12.3.0. The separately authorized installation will follow upstream --uv, capture resolution/versions and package-manager consistency, and retain this discrepancy as runtime/package qualification evidence. Installer success or inconsistency alone is neither a technical pass nor a runtime failure. No pin override, candidate substitution or installation has been performed.
dependency_install.install_protocol: Qualification document section 12; machine-local exact-command proposal in reports/img_forge_100/forge-install-protocol.md. Installation-only --exit and --skip-torch-cuda-test are distinct from subsequent physical runtime flags.

not_mapped: HuggingFace cache used by the ADetailer extension
model_reference.consequence: ADetailer detector models are not made visible by the model reference; see adetailer.detector_resolution.

adetailer.mediapipe_substitution: forbidden (StableNew's accepted contract is the REST payload with YOLO detectors)

detector_resolution.offline_flag: --ad-no-huggingface (cmd_opts.ad_no_huggingface): local-files-only lookup; absent detectors resolve INVALID and are dropped
detector_resolution.hard_gate: If face_yolov8n.pt or hand_yolov8n.pt cannot be resolved from an existing local directory, STOP before downloading anything and return the evidence.

forge_neo_compatibility_review.static_imports: every modules.* symbol the extension imports exists in Neo at the pinned commit (processing.StableDiffusionProcessing, create_binary_mask, devices.NansException, sd_samplers.all_samplers, sd_schedulers.schedulers, ui_components.InputAccordion, safe.unsafe_torch_load, paths.extensions_dir/extensions_builtin_dir/models_path, img2img, images, script_callbacks, scripts, shared, sd_models, extensions)
forge_neo_compatibility_review.not_proven: Static symbol presence is not behavioral evidence. Ecosystem reports of Forge Neo + ADetailer incompatibilities were not verified from the cloud session; only a physical run proves the REST contract.
forge_neo_compatibility_review.if_incompatible: STOP. Do not cycle through community forks silently; return the incompatibility and candidate evidence for owner adjudication.

controlnet.stage: none (StableNew has no ControlNet image stage; none is added by this package)
controlnet.qualification: read-only: confirm the script is listed by /sdapi/v1/scripts, confirm referenced ControlNet model directories are visible, mutate/download nothing

same_contract: POST /sdapi/v1/options (sd_model_checkpoint handled via checkpoint_change; unknown model raises)

different.vae_listing: GET /sdapi/v1/sd-modules (VAE + text encoders, entries {model_name, filename}); there is no /sdapi/v1/sd-vae
different.vae_selection: the sd_vae option is a non-interactive 'Automatic' placeholder; the effective VAE is the forge_additional_modules option (written by module name, read back as file paths); unknown module names are silently dropped
different.per_request_vae: override_settings.sd_vae is handled specially in modules/processing.py (_vae_override); behavior requires physical confirmation

api_surface_reviewed.identity_evidence: /sdapi/v1/cmd-flags contains forge_ref_a1111_home AND /sdapi/v1/sd-modules returns a list
